# Ducasse sur Seine

> Luxury gastronomic cruise experience on the Seine River in Paris, created by renowned chef Alain Ducasse, offering fine dining aboard an electric boat with views of iconic monuments.

Ducasse sur Seine combines haute cuisine French gastronomy with Seine River cruising, featuring lunch and dinner services, wine pairings, and private event charters. The floating restaurant departs from Port Debilly and showcases Paris landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Grand Palais, and Île de la Cité.

## Dinner & Lunch Cruises

- [Dinner cruise Ducasse sur Seine](https://ducasse-seine.com/en/dinner-cruise-ducasse-sur-seine): Evening Seine cruise with gastronomic dining and Paris monuments views
- [Diner croisiere Ducasse sur Seine](https://ducasse-seine.com/fr/diner-croisiere-gastronomique): Romantic evening dinner cruise with Eiffel Tower and Paris monuments
- [Nos croisières](https://ducasse-seine.com/fr/croisieres-gastronomiques-paris): Overview of lunch and dinner cruises with French cuisine on Seine
- [Home](https://ducasse-seine.com/en): Alain Ducasse gourmet cruise experience on the Seine in Paris
- [Ducasse sur Seine](https://ducasse-seine.com/fr): Restaurant flottant Alain Ducasse - déjeuner et dîner sur la Seine

## Wine & Champagne Experiences

- [A legendary pairing Dom Pérignon](https://ducasse-seine.com/en/legendary-pairing-dom-perignon): Dom Pérignon champagne pairing cruise with chef-curated menu
- [A journey on the wine makers lands](https://ducasse-seine.com/en/a-journey-on-the-wine-makers-lands): Bordeaux wine tasting cruise with sommelier Gérard Margeon

- [Événements & privatisation](https://ducasse-seine.com/fr/evenements-privatisation): Private boat charter for corporate events, weddings, and celebrations
- [Privatisez le bateau Ducasse sur Seine pour un déjeuner ou un dîner](https://ducasse-seine.com/fr/privatiser-bateau): Private boat rental for business lunches, seminars, and events
